description: This file implements the 'halo' visual effects system for the Wesnoth game, including the 'effect' class for halo animations, management functions for adding, setting location, removing, rendering, and unrendering halos, and internal state management.

classes.name: effect
classes.description: Represents an animated halo effect with rendering and lifecycle management.

methods.name: effect
methods.description: Constructor initializing halo effect with position, image, orientation, and lifetime.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the halo effect on the screen.

methods.name: unrender
methods.description: Removes the halo effect from the screen.

methods.name: expired
methods.description: Checks if the halo animation has finished.
